content.title: How to watch Guardians vs. Mariners: TV channel and streaming options for March 28
content.text: The Cleveland Guardians will look for another big outing from a batter on a roll against the Seattle Mariners on Saturday at 9:40 p.m. ET, at T-Mobile Park. Chase DeLauter is currently on a two-game homer streak. Bryan Woo (0-0, 0.00 ERA) gets the start for the Mariners, who are 1-1 this season and second in the AL West.
